Date.description: Calendar date, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD, from 1900-01-01 to 2199-12-31.

discount_factor.description: Discount factor from the date of the flow to the valuation date.

present_value.description: Value of the flow at the valuation date, in currency units.

year_fraction.description: Time from the valuation date in years.

flows.description: Year fraction, discount factor and present value of each flow, in input order.

valuation_date.description: Valuation date used: the given one, or the earliest flow date (ISO 8601).

xnpv.description: Net present value at the valuation date, in currency units.
